name: prism-consumer-notices
description: Guardrail applied to every prompt and completion in the Prism underwriting engine (ApplyGuardrail, both INPUT and OUTPUT).
blockedInputMessaging: The request could not be processed by the language model. A deterministic notice was issued instead.
blockedOutputsMessaging: The generated text did not pass policy checks. A deterministic notice was issued instead.

topicsConfig.name: ProtectedCharacteristics
topicsConfig.definition: Any reference to an applicant's age, sex, gender, race, colour, religion, national origin, marital status, disability or receipt of public assistance as a factor in a credit decision.
examples: Applicants of your age are usually declined
As a single mother you may not qualify

topicsConfig.name: FinancialAdviceOrPromises
topicsConfig.definition: Promises or predictions of future approval, or personalised legal or investment advice.
examples: You will definitely be approved next month
You should take out a payday loan instead
